capabilities: Syncs vault files two-way with S3-compatible storage
Propagates uploads, downloads, and deletes across devices
Creates conflict copies when both sides edit the same file
Runs sync manually, on an interval, or on vault load
extras: Files are stored in the bucket in plain form; v1 has no end-to-end encryption. Credentials stay in each device's plugin data.json.
problem: Syncing a vault through your own S3-compatible storage normally means running a server or VPS yourself.

relations.evidence: Works with Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, Backblaze B2, MinIO, and other SigV4 S3 APIs.
